newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast prods notionally flat late Friday.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast prods notionally flat late Friday.

text.p: U.S. West Coast spot products remained notionally flat late Friday amid typical thin pre-weekend trade, dealers said.
NYMEX January gasoline rose 2.32 cents a gallon to 67.04 cents amid forecasts of cold temperatures in the eastern U.S. and options expiry.
Front-month heating oil jumped 3.04 cents a gallon to 71.71 cents a gallon on Friday.
Los Angeles conventional gasoline stayed around 68/69 cents a gallon.
CARB grade gasoline jumped 3.50 cents to 70.50 cents amid increased buying and higher NYMEX values. January barrels stood two cents higher.
Jet fuel rose 2.50 cents to 75/76 cents on firmer futures, traders said.
